name: Coral Glow
css:
/* Coral Glow: a glowing coral reef with drifting jellyfish under shafts of sunlight (original illustration, no fish). The reef sits in the free strip right of the conversation; the jellyfish glow pulses while the agent works, frosted sea-glass panels float over deep teal water, and a bioluminescent line over the composer grows as the context fills. Dark only. */
